connector.name: NoonAI Automatic Video Face Blur MCP
connector.registryDescription: YOLO auto-detects faces for image/video anonymization; face-only blur, body and plate masking.
connector.summary: Hosted at noon-ai.dyndns-server.com over streamable HTTP. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.dyndns-server.noon-ai, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.
